text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool eu3 (eu-west-3-dedicated-pool) p99 latency > 5s for streaming endpoints for last 3m. SLOs degraded. Paging on-call.
alice_sre: i'm on it — seeing big queue depth on pool eu3. p95 ~1.2s but p99 jumps to 6-8s for streaming requests. :warning:
bob_oncall: pinged. grabbing logs. any customer-visible hits yet?
sam_runtime: yes — a handful of customers reported stalls in streaming chat (tokens not flowing). Cloudwatch shows steady exec on gpus but new instances are stuck in warmup for ~75-120s.
tahira_prod: triage: are warmup handshakes failing or just slow? metrics pls.
alice_sre: snapshot queries: 
```
SUM(queue_depth) BY pool WHERE pool="eu3" -> 420 at peak
rolling_avg(warmup_time, 5m) -> 85s
streaming_retries{pool="eu3"} -> +320 in 10m
p99_latency{pool="eu3",endpoint="streaming"} -> 6.3s
```
clara_engplatform: autoscaler logs show delayed allocation: provision request to orbit-returner queued, kube-scheduler pending because of node label mismatch on GPU type. looks like recent deploy added a nodeSelector requiring nvidia-a100-v2 which isn't available in eu3 region capacity now.
bob_oncall: that would explain warmup stalls — scheduler waiting for specific GPU nodes. can we fallback to compatible instance type temporarily?
sam_runtime: we can, but need config change in pool profile. i can run a manual scale and change nodeSelector to allow a100-v1 as fallback for burst.
mike_custsuccess: at least two customers (acct: high-traffic-chat, acct: realtime-summaries) reported degraded UX ~12:45UTC. CS getting tickets. scorecard shows they hit streaming timeouts.
alice_sre: mitigation plan: 1) open fallback nodeSelector so autoscaler can provision a100-v1 nodes 2) increase pool target by +4 nodes manually 3) reroute 30% of traffic to eu2 for streaming-only users as temporary fallback 4) adjust handshake timeout from 90s -> 40s to allow faster failover.
bob_oncall: i'm ready to run commands. sam, can you post the exact rictl commands?
sam_runtime: running now: 
```
# allow fallback gpu type
rictl pool update eu3 --nodeSelector "gpu.type in (a100-v2,a100-v1)"
# manual scale
rictl pool scale eu3 --replicas 6
# adjust handshake timeout
rictl config set --pool eu3 --handshake_timeout 40
```
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: pool-profile change -> pending approval (auto-approve enabled for oncall). :white_check_mark:
alice_sre: executing reroute via traffic-router: reducing weight eu3 -> 70%, eu2 -> 30% for streaming-routes. doing incremental steps.
clara_engplatform: quick heads up: nodeSelector change will trigger node affinity changes; we should watch for kube evictions. logging enabled.
bob_oncall: manual scale return: 3 new nodes provisioning, but one pending due to image pull timeout. looks like NFS health degraded for boot images. ops infra alerted.
alice_sre: okay cut the reroute back to 50/50 until we see stable nodes.
mike_custsuccess: telling impacted customers we're routing traffic to a healthy region, ETA ~10-15m. will update status page.
tahira_prod: also noticed KV cache cold miss rate spiked — streaming tails re-requests cold KV which amplifies load during warmup. recommend enabling transient KV warmup for hot clients.
sam_runtime: enabling kv prewarm for top-5 clients now. command:
```
rictl kv prewarm --pool eu3 --clients high-traffic-chat,realtime-summaries --duration 5m
```
alice_sre: after the manual scale and nodeSelector change, p99 dropped to ~2.1s and steaming stall counts dropped 70% over 6m. still above target but improving. continuing to monitor.
bob_oncall: image-pull issue resolved by infra; all new nodes ready. autoscaler reconcile in progress.
clara_engplatform: note: long-term fix: revert nodeSelector change and instead add fallback pool with different GPU SKU for burst. will open a PR for pool profiles.
alice_sre: customer impact summary: ~3 customers saw intermittent streaming stalls, some tokens delayed up to 10s; no data loss, mostly UX timeouts. Severity: P2 -> P1 escalation considered but containment in progress. CS flagged two enterprise accounts; recommend post-incident follow-up.
mike_custsuccess: will draft CS notes and send apology + mitigation ETA. keep me posted when we hit stable p99 < 1s.
sam_runtime: autoscaler back to normal; warmup median down to 22s. handshake timeout change helped faster fallback. rolling revert scheduled after 30m stabilization.
alice_sre: action items:
- clara: PR for fallback pool + pool profiles (due EOD)
- sam: revert handshake_timeout after 30m if stable and document prewarm step (due +1h)
- bob: run RCA stub and collect scheduler+kube events for root cause (due +2h)
- mike: customer comms (immediate)

alice_sre: marking incident as "mitigated" for livepage. keep thread open for RCA notes and postmortem. thank you everyone for fast response. :tada:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Mitigation applied, latency improving, monitoring in watch mode. Closed pager once p99 < 1.5s for 15m.
